name_note: The species was described as Clostridium bartlettii and later reclassified into the genus Intestinibacter.

sentences.text: Intestinibacter bartlettii was created by reclassifying Clostridium bartlettii into a novel genus, of which it is the type species.
A real-time PCR analysis of faeces from 18 healthy adults identified predominant colonization of Intestinibacter bartlettii in the human large intestine.
A randomized trial in overweight or obese adults reported that metformin treatment decreased Intestinibacter bartlettii at both 6 and 12 months compared with control.
